ns2:section.sectionText: SP22 ENGL 350: Multi-ethnic Women Writers: This section of “Writing about Literature, Text, and Culture” will focus on multi-ethnic women writers. We will engage with novels, short stories, travelogues, films, and critical works by women from Africa, the Caribbean, India, and the South Americas. Our work for the course will also involve understanding the temporal and spatial contexts in which the texts we encounter were shaped and the assignments you will be asked to produce in response will ask you to similarly ground the texts you are writing about.
